stem:
The graph shows the first ionisation energies of some of the elements in Group 2.

{{figure:pdf_visual_01.png}}

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Write an equation for the first ionisation energy of $\text{Mg}$.

Include state symbols.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Explain the observed trend in first ionisation energies down Group 2.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
The second ionisation energy of $\text{Be}$ is $1757\text{ kJ mol}^{-1}$.

Explain why the second ionisation energy of $\text{Be}$ is higher than the first ionisation energy of $\text{Be}$.
